name: Diphenhydramine
warning: Deliriant presentation is deliberately unsettling: realistic peripheral hallucinations, shadow figures, insect-like motion. One-time confirmation required.
tierNotes: Threshold: unease — slight darkening, nothing nameable.
Light: first dark specks in the corners of the frame.
Common: skitter clusters in periphery/dark regions + smoke wisps drifting; blur waves begin.
Strong: shadow faces fading in from the darkest regions, dissolving on approach; heavy blur waves.
Heavy: 'someone standing there' figure events, near-monochrome sickly cast, constant peripheral motion.
